text:
Mia (Sales): Quick sync on Elior Health POC — they want a 2-week trial starting Mon 2026-05-12. Main asks: latency <=200ms p50 for short prompts (<=64 tokens), avg cost < $0.0007/token, and quality pass rate >=92% on their eval set. Also need KMS + SOC2 checklist answers. Can Alex confirm feasibility and suggested model/quant/route? cc @Alex

Alex (SE): Short answer: likely yes for p50 on low-latency Dedicated hardware but need traffic shape. For <=64 tokens and p50 200ms I'd target H100 or c7-like instance with batch=1. Suggested config: Llama2-70B-q4/vram-optimized kernels + prefix KV caching. For cost target we should use q4 + caching + request-level routing. Need their sample prompts and eval runner. Are they ok with fallback to a smaller variant for spikes?

Tara (CS): From CS side: their eval set is ~1,200 queries across 3 classes: extraction (50%), summarization (30%), clinical QA (20%). Per-class acceptance: extraction >=94%, summarization >=90%, QA >=90%. They want pass on all classes.

Mia (Sales): Uploading eval.zip to the customer S3 bucket now (link in email). They favor Dedicated for predictability. Typical baseline traffic: ~20 RPS, spike up to 100 RPS. They want a runbook for canary and cutover.

Alex (SE): If Dedicated: propose 2x H100-80GB for baseline with autoscale policy to add GPUs at spikes. For initial perf tests I'll spin up a 1-GPU canary and run the eval set under synthetic load. Action items: 1) Alex: build perf test harness & run with their eval. 2) Sam: post KMS/SOC2/HSM notes. 3) Tara: confirm scoring script and upload to bucket.

Sam (Security): KMS is supported via customer-managed KMS for Private/Dedicated. SOC2 answers are standard; I'll paste the abbreviated checklist into the doc. If they require FIPS-certified HSM, need ~2 weeks lead time and approvals. Also confirm key rotation policy requirement.

Mia (Sales): Cost ask: customer wants a burn estimate for their 1,200-query eval (avg 80 tokens/output). Can Alex provide per-token cost estimate and a total?

Alex (SE): Quick calc (rough): with q4 inference perf we observe ~0.00045/token inference-only on Dedicated. Add infra amortization + networking ~0.00012/token => ~0.00057/token. For 1,200 * 80 = 96,000 tokens => ~$54.7. Add 25% buffer for retries/spikes => ~$68.4. That keeps us under their $0.0007/token target. I'll drop the spreadsheet in the thread.

Tara (CS): :thumbsup: Test plan: run the eval twice, 24 hours apart, to verify stability. Acceptance rule: if any class drops >2% between runs or below thresholds we fail. Also require latency/cost report attached.

Mia (Sales): Next steps and owners: Alex -> perf prototype by Fri 2026-05-08; Sam -> KMS/HSM + SOC2 snippet today; Tara -> load scoring script into bucket and run initial scoring. I'll draft the SOW with the acceptance matrix and timeline and circulate for sign-off.

DeployBot: Canary deployment started: canary-elior-2026-05-04 by alex_se. Status: provisioning.

Alex (SE): Noted. I'll post perf logs and the first run summary in #eng-releases once the canary completes. If we see latency >200ms p50 on <=64 token prompts we'll try quant kernel tweaks and smaller batch size. Escalate to eng-runtime if needed.
